allow.description: allow (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#allow 192.168.0.0/16).

authselectmode.description: authselectmode (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#authselectmode require).

driftfile.description: driftfile (as documented in the shipped file).

hwtimestamp_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to enable hardware timestamping on (if supported by NIC/kernel). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#hwtimestamp *).

keyfile.description: Path to NTP authentication keys file (e.g., '/etc/chrony/chrony.keys'). Leave empty to disable auth.

leapsec_mode.description: How to handle leap seconds: 'system' (kernel steps), 'step' (chronyd steps), 'slew' (gradual), or 'ignore'. Default is 'system' on Linux. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#leapsecmode slew).

leapsectz.description: leapsectz (as documented in the shipped file).

local_stratum.description: Stratum level for the local reference mode. Must be 1-15. Default 10. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#local stratum 10).

logdir.description: logdir (as documented in the shipped file).

logging_destinations.description: Types of data to log (e.g., measurements, statistics, tracking). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#log measurements statistics tracking).

makestep_threshold.description: If initial clock offset > this (seconds), allow stepping (non-slew) for up to `makestep_burst_count` updates.

minsources.description: minsources (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#minsources 2).

ntsdumpdir.description: ntsdumpdir (as documented in the shipped file).

pool.description: pool (as documented in the shipped file).

sourcedir.description: sourcedir (as documented in the shipped file).
